description: Businesses listed on Google Maps by name and/or category in a country, optionally within a radius of a point: up to 50 with name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, coordinates, price level and place id (no reviews or photos), from Google Maps business listings, $0.08 a call. Use when building local lead lists or auditing a market. No match is an empty answer, still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.08 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

category.description: A Google business category id, lower case with underscores (pizza_restaurant, coffee_shop, dentist, ...).

coordinates.description: Only businesses within a radius of a point: lat,lng,radius: latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180 (up to 7 decimals), radius 1-100 km (whole number; default 10).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the businesses (us, gb, de, ...).

q.description: Words in the business name (at most 100 characters). q or category is required.

name: business_listings
title: Business listings by name or category (up to 50)
